need: an interval on each configuration's pass rate, and on the paired difference between two configurations
why: to say whether the frontier steps above the lean, each under a point, are more than noise
workaround: carried the missing interval as an open caveat; prose states each gain as a point estimate and price steps as derived arithmetic

need: options_dominance that weighs a quality axis when the campaign declared none, and lets the axes it is given feed dominated_by
why: with no criteria it ranks on cost alone and names Nano-XS with reasoning off and no retry, the lowest pass rate of all, dominant; axes are listed but change nothing
workaround: read the pass-rate frontier from price_tradeoff and said on the page why the report disagrees with code's dominance call

need: a latency axis in options_dominance read on p95 (or p50), the statistics the latency measure holds
why: the axis reads the mean, which latency_ms does not carry, so every arm shows no figure and dominant_with_axes comes back empty
workaround: read p50 and p95 with measure_read and drew them as range bars

need: decision_sensitivity over a hypothetical floor or budget the campaign never declared
why: to say where the cheapest qualifying configuration changes as a pass-rate floor or a p95 budget moves
workaround: wrote the explore controls in words from the frontier's own pass-rate and p95 keys

need: a cost unit that matches the measure: cost_per_1k is per 1k calls, but the usd_per_1k filter and the lattice print per 1,000 replies
why: to cite cost per call without mislabelling it, and to know whether the declared monthly volume counts tasks or calls
workaround: cited cost per month keys instead of per-1k figures in prose; carried the cost basis as a caveat

need: a within-cell factor effect: what one retry (or one reasoning level) changes in each model and reasoning cell
why: to state that retry helps in every cell and by how much, without averaging over an interaction
workaround: the lattice shows each cell side by side; prose cites the one retry step price_tradeoff keys (Nano-XS, reasoning off)

need: a block that draws price_tradeoff's steps: price per point between adjacent frontier options, with the band each holds
why: the knee in price per point is the lead finding, and no block shows the steps as rows
workaround: the frontier scatter carries the shape; the step prices appear in prose and decision slots by their keys

need: the frontier marked in scatter_frontier's values table, and points labelled by arm name and tag rather than id
why: a reader of the values table can't tell which points sit on the Pareto line, and ids are not reader names
workaround: the caption names the frontier options, read from price_tradeoff

need: a slice comparison between two named arms when there is no control (measure_breakdown refuses without one), and case counts per task
why: to say whether multi-hop's shortfall is separated for the lean, and how many cases each task holds
workaround: showed the four options by task as a descriptive heatmap and called the pattern a lead

need: settle: the cases needed to separate two configurations' pass rates
why: to say how large a paired rerun of the lean against the next frontier step must be
workaround: named the rerun as a next step without a case count

need: caveats_list entries for caveats the snapshot plainly carries: no interval on any figure, selection from eighteen configurations, no stated definition of pass
why: confidence caveats need ids the editor can check; the list is empty
workaround: wrote my own caveat ids with material_if clauses

need: price_tradeoff on a per-task cost basis: each option's cost per call times its calls per task, at a volume that counts tasks
why: the value-per-point bands the owner is asked to declare against move with the basis, and whether the declared volume counts tasks or calls is not stated
workaround: the cost-basis caveat names each shortlisted option's calls per task and says every dollar band moves with the basis; a next step asks the owner to state the basis

need: a keyed gain between two named arms within one task (for example multi-hop, lean to the next frontier step)
why: to say how much more the step above the lean buys on its weakest task than overall
workaround: watch cites both arms' multi-hop rates by key and compares them with the overall gain in words

need: failure counts by outcome type for an arm (a census of its failures, not the cards the snapshot froze)
why: to say whether the lean's failure cards represent where its losses concentrate
workaround: c6 is scoped to the frozen cards as a sample, and cites the one share a card states in its own reason text

need: pass rates printed at one consistent precision (98.0%, not 98%), with gains that match the printed rates
why: gains are computed before rounding, so a quoted gain can differ from the difference of the printed rates and the page disagrees with itself
workaround: a Method line explains the rounding; gains are cited only by key

need: reader labels in scatter_frontier values tables, and no gate pills on lattice tiles when no gate was declared
why: the scatter's points are labelled by raw arm id, and every lattice tile reads 'Not gated here', which is noise on an ungated campaign
workaround: c3 moved to a table block, which labels arms by name; the lattice caption explains the pills

need: figure keys for counts (configurations per model, frontier steps above an option, failure cards per arm)
why: counts written as words in prose are typed numbers under the figure-key rule
workaround: rewrote the sentences to carry no count
